verdict.rationale: Notion offers databases with properties that can be created and updated (notion-docs-13, notion-docs-26, notion-docs-3), and community users report using it as a project tracker for tasks and projects (notion-comm-6, notion-comm-11, notion-comm-15, notion-comm-1). The evidence only implies initiative tracking; it never shows status, priority, or team-ownership fields, and one user says they hit limits when using it as a tracker (notion-comm-6). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of status/priority properties, team-ownership assignment, initiative or roadmap templates, and hands-on corroboration of PM initiative tracking.
